verdict.rationale: React is a client-side UI library that neither holds nor serves production data, so a sandbox-versus-production data environment is the wrong axis for this product type. The 'Try editing this sandbox!' item describes an online code playground for learning React, not an isolated test environment that protects production data. That makes it a different capability, and it does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
